# Erigeron (sensu lato) species mapper # - Species table -> selectize dropdown (with color swatches) # - Phylogeny (ggtree) below the dropdown; tips use the same colored circles as the map library(shiny) library(shinyWidgets) library(shinylive) library(httpuv) library(tidyverse) library(leaflet) library(RColorBrewer) library(htmltools) library(bslib) library(geojsonsf) library(rmapshaper) library(sf) library(ape) library(ggtree) ### Load Erigeron phylogeny tree <- read.tree("erigeron_ingroup_all_phylo_2026-10-07.tree") # Close to done, but needs updating probably tree$tip.label <- str_trim(gsub(pattern = "_", replacement = " ", tree$tip.label)) ### Load species names data table erigeron_sp <- read.csv("erigeron_sampling.csv") erigeron_sp_subset <- erigeron_sp %>% arrange(scientificName) %>% select(scientificName, sectName, country) %>% mutate(scientificName = str_trim(scientificName)) %>% distinct() %>% filter(scientificName %in% tree$tip.label) erigeron_sp_subset[is.na(erigeron_sp_subset)] <- "" ### Load specimen data and clean up for mapping gbif_parq <- nanoparquet::read_parquet("gbif_erigeron_acceptedNames.parquet") %>% filter(!is.na(species), species != "") %>% mutate(species = str_trim(species), scientificName2 = str_trim(scientificName2)) obs_tbl <- gbif_parq %>% rename(lat = decimalLatitude, lng = decimalLongitude) %>% filter(species %in% erigeron_sp_subset$scientificName) ### ONE shared, reproducible color mapping (map, dropdown and tree all use this) sp_levels <- sort(unique(obs_tbl$species)) set.seed(42) # fixed seed -> same colors every launch sp_cols <- setNames(sample(scales::hue_pal(l = 60, c = 100)(length(sp_levels))), sp_levels) pal <- colorFactor(palette = unname(sp_cols), domain = sp_levels, levels = sp_levels) ### Species table: one row per species (for the dropdown) species_tbl <- erigeron_sp_subset %>% filter(scientificName %in% obs_tbl$species) %>% rename(species = scientificName, section = sectName) %>% group_by(species) %>% summarise( section = paste(unique(section[section != ""]), collapse = "; "), country = paste(unique(country[country != ""]), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop" ) %>% mutate(color = unname(sp_cols[species])) ### HTML for each dropdown entry (color dot + species + section + country) dot <- function(col) sprintf( "", col) picker_content <- with(species_tbl, paste0( dot(color), "", htmlEscape(species), "", ifelse(section != "", paste0(" | ", htmlEscape(section), ""), "") )) picker_tokens <- with(species_tbl, paste(species, section, country)) ### Build UI ui <- fluidPage( fluidRow( column(10, titlePanel("Erigeron (sensu lato) species mapper")), column(2, div(style = "text-align:right; margin-top:20px;", actionButton("aboutBtn", "About", icon = icon("circle-info")))) ), tags$head( tags$link(rel = "shortcut icon", href = "./mountain_and_flower.png") ), fluidRow( column( 5, h4("Select one or more species"), pickerInput( "species_sel", label = NULL, width = "100%", multiple = TRUE, choices = species_tbl$species, choicesOpt = list( content = picker_content, # HTML: color dot + species + section + country tokens = picker_tokens # extra text the search box matches on ), options = pickerOptions( liveSearch = TRUE, actionsBox = TRUE, # "Select All / Deselect All" buttons selectedTextFormat = "count > 2", # "3 selected" instead of a long string countSelectedText = "{0} species selected", noneSelectedText = "Species | Section ", size = 12, container = "body" ) ), actionButton("clearSelectionBtn", "Clear Selection"), plotOutput("tree_plot", height = "75vh") ), column( 7, fluidRow( column( 3, sliderInput("range", "Collection year range:", min = 1900, max = 2025, value = c(1900, 2025)) ), column( 2, switchInput( inputId = "activeFilter", label = "Show only imaged specimens", value = TRUE, onStatus = "success", offStatus = "danger" ) ) ), leafletOutput("map", height = "78vh") ) ) ) # Server server <- function(input, output, session) { ### "About" pop-up observeEvent(input$aboutBtn, { showModal(modalDialog( title = "About this app", HTML("How to use: Select one or more species from the drop-down menu (upper left). Species names and sections are shown and searchable (e.g., you can select all Erigeron subsection Tridactylia). In the future, I hope to have an interactive and zoom-able phylogeny. Please let me know if you want to suggest any other improvements or ideas at jak566@cornell.edu!

About: Data downloaded from GBIF shows preserved specimens collected between 1900-2025. Species not in the phylogeny are omitted here, and not all species are represented (i.e., rare taxa)

GBIF data: GBIF.org (15 October 2025) GBIF Occurrence Download https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.n983dr

Phylogeny: Phylogenetic relationships inferred from a coalescent species-tree analysis of 1030 Erigeron-specific single-copy loci (ms in preparation)

Author: Joseph is a PhD candidate advised by Dr. Hannah Marx. Email: jak566@cornell.edu. Website: jkleinkopf.github.io"), easyClose = TRUE, # click outside or press Esc to close footer = modalButton("Close"), size = "m" )) }) observeEvent(input$clearSelectionBtn, { updatePickerInput(session, "species_sel", selected = character(0)) }) # Reactive filter: only runs when the selection changes filtered_obs <- reactive({ selected_species <- input$species_sel if (length(selected_species) == 0) return(NULL) dat <- obs_tbl %>% filter(species %in% selected_species, between(year, input$range[1], input$range[2])) if (input$activeFilter) dat %>% filter(mediaType == "StillImage") else dat }) ### Phylogeny: selected species get the same fill color as their map circles; ### everything else is light grey. n_tips <- Ntip(tree) max_x <- max(node.depth.edgelength(tree)) output$tree_plot <- renderPlot({ sel <- input$species_sel tipdat <- tibble(label = tree$tip.label) %>% mutate( is_sel = label %in% sel, tip_fill = ifelse(is_sel, unname(sp_cols[label]), "transparent"), tip_line = ifelse(is_sel, "black", "transparent"), txt_col = ifelse(is_sel, unname(sp_cols[label]), "black") ) w <- session$clientData$output_tree_plot_width req(w) lab_size <- w / 250 ggtree(tree, ladderize = T, layout = "circular", linewidth = 0.2) %<+% tipdat + geom_tiplab(aes(color = txt_col), fontface = "italic", size = lab_size, offset = max_x * 0.02) + geom_tippoint(aes(fill = tip_fill, color = tip_line), shape = 21, size = lab_size * 1.5, stroke = 0.2) + scale_fill_identity() + scale_color_identity() }) ### Initialize leaflet map output$map <- renderLeaflet({ static_options <- leafletOptions( zoomControl = TRUE, dragging = TRUE, minZoom = 2, maxZoom = 18, preferCanvas = TRUE ) leaflet(options = static_options) %>% setView(lng = -105, lat = 45, zoom = 3) %>% addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap, group = "Esri Topo (default)") %>% addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap.Mapnik, group = "OpenStreetMap") %>% addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap, group = "OpenTopoMap (contours)") %>% addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite (Esri)") %>% addLayersControl( baseGroups = c("Esri Topo (default)", "OpenStreetMap", "OpenTopoMap (contours)", "Satellite (Esri)"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = TRUE), position = "topright" ) }) ### Update points without reloading the base map observe({ dat <- filtered_obs() leafletProxy("map", data = dat) %>% clearMarkers() %>% clearControls() if (!is.null(dat) && nrow(dat) > 0) { leafletProxy("map", data = dat) %>% addCircleMarkers( lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, radius = 6, weight = 1, color = "black", fillColor = ~pal(species), fillOpacity = 0.65, popup = ~paste0("", scientificName2, "", "
", "Institution: ", institutionCode, "
", "Year collected: ", year, "
GBIF Record: Link") %>% lapply(htmltools::HTML), label = ~paste0("", scientificName2, "", "
Click to view more info") %>% lapply(htmltools::HTML) ) %>% addLegend(position = "bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~species, title = "Selected Species", opacity = 1) } }) } shinyApp(ui, server)
